notes: UNVERIFIED CANDIDATES — NOT PLAYABLE. Covers the 14 batch-001 failures that batch 002 did not replace (Tunisia, Madagascar, Tanzania, Uganda, Fiji, American Samoa, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Bolivia, Mongolia, Jordan, Bhutan, Jamaica, Greenland). Those areas are NOT retried: every one is a territory where a single sample failed and where official coverage is genuinely sparse, so the replacement is a location in a country with PROVEN coverage on the same continent — proven meaning a batch-001 candidate there actually verified. Weighted to the balance gates that got worse rather than better after batch 001 landed: normal/suburban is 7.7% against a 20% bar and normal/rural-remote 11.5% against 15%, so 27 of 36 candidates are Normal. City-edge suburban locations also have far better verification odds than remote roads, so the greatest need and the highest-probability candidates happen to coincide.

candidates.rationale: Replaces tanzania-kilimanjaro-road. Rwanda is PROVEN — musanze-hills verified 19 m off target — and Africa is 8 groups below its continent floor.
